quest.title: A Surprise Gift
quest.description: Rudolf wants to send a gift to his wife, Jilliana, but has no idea what to give her. He's at a loss about what to do...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x1600, Treasure Hoarder Insignia x3

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How about Marjorie, who runs the souvenir shop?

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Marjorie? Oh, right, she runs that souvenir shop, doesn't she? She certainly would have some choice goods on sale.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Could I trouble you to make a trip over to her shop for me? Lily's out at the moment, so I need to wait here until she gets back, since Jilliana's still at work.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Besides, I want to give her a surprise, so I can't afford to let her know...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I... I didn't bring enough.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Going shopping without money — were you expecting me to give this to you for free, or something?

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Oh, come on, don't just stand there at the door with that hard-done-by look on your face, people will get the wrong idea.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Okay, I've got it. How about this: You go get me some Windwheel Asters, and once you do, I'll give you this present.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Well, aren't you straightforward. Alright, I've already wrapped the present. Take it.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Oh, yes. Don't open it, you hear? Presents are meant to be surprises, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Opening others' presents is hardly considered polite, either.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Did you get a present from Marjorie?

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: Oh! Thank you... Wait, did you buy this?

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: H—How much was it? I'll reimburse you.

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: I mean, it's a present from me to Jilliana. I can't just spend your money, or hers...

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: I did save a little on the sly. Hold on a moment, let me get it... This should be enough, yes?

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: I do hope that Jilliana will like it...

talks.objective: Give the Windwheel Aster to Marjorie

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Did you get a present from Marjorie?

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: Thank you. How much was it? Let me reimburse you...

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: I do hope that Jilliana will like it...

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: You traded for it? Marjorie took Windwheel Asters in exchange for the present?

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: What would she need those for... Forget it. Please take these with my thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: These should be plenty.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Here's the present you wanted. But do remember to bring enough money next time you go shopping.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How about Quinn, the fruit seller?

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Him? Ha, good luck getting any good ideas out of him!

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: It's true that I don't know what to give Jilliana. But I fear that he'd have more trouble than me if he were asked to pick something to give Beatrice.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Still, you may as well go ask him. For all we know, he might stumble upon the right solution entirely by accident.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Could I trouble you to make the trip for me? Lily's out at the moment, so I need to wait here until she gets back.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How about Sara from Good Hunter?

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Huh. Could we get anything special from a restaurant?

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Still, you won't know if you don't try... If all else fails, we can order some delicious takeaway.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Well, could I trouble you to make the trip? Lily's out at the moment, so I need to wait here until she gets back.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: That girl, who knows where she's run off to this time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, Rudolf wants to give Jilliana a present...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Rudolf wants to do that? But if you've come to me... Do you mean to order some specialties?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Other than specialties, you won't find anything special here.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Alright, I can whip something up for you if you insist...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Well, then I'll get to it. In the meantime, could you help me deliver Norma's order to her?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: It's best eaten hot, so you'll have to hurry before it cools.

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: Thanks a lot! Off you go.

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: Yup, thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Norma
dialogues.text: It should be here any minute...

response.speaker: Norma
response.text: Whoa! You gave me a scare. Your delivery service is really quick.

response.speaker: Norma
response.text: It's still warm, too. I don't have to warm it up again. Thank you.

response.speaker: Norma
response.text: Why do I need to order in even though I live in the city? Well, the thing is...

response.speaker: Norma
response.text: Pre-made food is really convenient, and it means I don't have to wash the dishes or clean the kitchen.

response.speaker: Norma
response.text: I don't know how to make a lot of dishes, either, so I've long grown sick of my own cooking...

choices.text: I believe this is your order.

response.speaker: Norma
response.text: Whoa, you scared me! Yes, this is the dish I ordered... You sure do deliver quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The dish has gone cold...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Ugh, this dish has already gone totally cold.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Guess there's no choice but to make another serving... Please make haste this time around.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Understood.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: It's done. Come now, there's no time to lose.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We've delivered the meal.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: You have? Great! That dish gets cold easily, and once it does, it's no longer good.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: I've also finished the specialty dish you ordered for Jilliana. Hehe, since we're both ladies, I'm sure she'll like it. Once she sees it, she'll probably also understand what I...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Alright, go give it to them. There's no rush to deliver this while it's hot. Perhaps you could even say that now isn't the time to eat it...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Hmm, how should I put this? When you want to eat it, you just need to warm it up a bit. As to the "when," we can leave that up to Jilliana.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Oh — and don't steal any bites, I haven't the time to make another serving!

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Have you obtained a present from Sara?

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: So you really did get it. I wonder what it is...

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: I can't see it? Well, alright then. I mean, I'm sure it's good...

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: A secret between women... I wonder what sort of secret dish that is?

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: Well, I have faith in Sara. These are for you — thanks for your help!

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: I hope Jilliana likes this gift...

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: A house specialty? I wonder what that is...

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: That Beatrice...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, Rudolf wants to give Jilliana a present...

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Rudolf wants to give his wife a present...

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: So, why are you asking me about that? I have no experience in this field, and I haven't had time to think about it...

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: What? Beatrice? What's she got to do with all this? Stop this nonsense!

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: *sigh* Alright, I get it. Let me help you think about this. But I'll need your help in exchange.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: A new batch of goods that I ordered hasn't arrived yet. Please help me look for it. I should have something thought out by the time you return...

response.speaker: Quinn
response.text: Great, thanks!

response.speaker: Quinn
response.text: Stop talking about that already!

response.speaker: Quinn
response.text: Just help me find those goods already, I'll be over here in the meantime, thinking about your special present...

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Well, did you find the cart with my goods?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Found it.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Great. What happened to the cargo? What? It was attacked by monsters?

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Those hateful fellows... Oh, you beat them back? Thank you so much!

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: The driver must have been scared off by those monsters. Still, we can't just leave the cart out there. I must inform the Knights of Favonius.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, about the present...?

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Oh, right. I have it right here. Well, perhaps I should say that Beatrice prepared it.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: I don't know why, but she's always been good at giving people gifts.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: I just brought it up with her, saying that I might have to give a gift to a female friend, and she had it ready in no time!

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: I've never seen her this fired up, either. Well, take care of it now. Beatrice's got a good eye for these things... I think.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Have you gotten a present from Quinn?

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: Did you really? Well, what do you know? Turns out Quinn actually can give people presents. Guess he's made some progress after all...

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: Huh? It was Beatrice who helped him? And he was the one who asked her?

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: Anemo Archon protect us... I... I really don't know what to say anymore.

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: But this present should be fine. Beatrice has a good eye.

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: And it wouldn't do for me to refuse...

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: Right, this is for you, as thanks for your help. I do hope that Jilliana will like this gift...

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: Beatrice? What, Beatrice helped Quinn prepare this present... and he asked her to help him with it?

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: This fellow, he hasn't made a lick of progress at all. In fact, he might be regressing...

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: So, have you found my goods yet?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's been some trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: What? The cart's broken down? Those dastardly monsters. And here I was, wondering why my goods hadn't arrived yet!

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: It's alright, this isn't your fault. I'll go find the Knights of Favonius in a moment. I can't just leave my goods out there like this.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: I'm sorry to trouble you, but could you help me out one more time? Please help me find a few sturdy wooden planks. I'd like to get the cart fixed. Otherwise, it's just going to be stuck over there.

response.speaker: Quinn
response.text: Thank you!

response.speaker: Quinn
response.text: Oh, don't you worry about it. It's only a small matter. Just come and see me after you find those planks.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Have you found those sturdy wooden planks?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yup.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Thanks for taking the trouble to help me. I'll bring the goods and the cart back in no time.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. This is the present, as we agreed. That said, Beatrice was the one who prepared it.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: She's always been good at picking presents. I mean, I just brought it up with her, saying that I might have to give a gift to a female friend, and she had this ready in no time at all.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: She's not this fired up usually, but she's got a good eye for these things, so there's no need to worry. Just take it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you tell Beatrice about the cart?

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: No, of course not. If she knew, there'd be no end to her nagging.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: And don't tell her either, please. I'm not looking forward to explaining this to her...

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Alright, you'd best hurry along and deliver that present. I'll go talk to the Knights of Favonius in just a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Have you gotten a present from Quinn?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I did.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Thank you so much. That fellow is very concerned about his business.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: As I thought, he didn't give up on that batch of goods. When it comes to business, nobody can make him see sense.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Wait. Beatrice helped him pick this? Really, that guy hasn't made any progress at all, has he?

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: It's been so many years, they should really just... *sigh* Those two...

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Thank you so much for your help. I'll take this with me. I believe in Beatrice's eye for presents.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: This is a token of my appreciation. Please take it.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: I do hope that Jilliana will like it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Vile might have some suggestions for us.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Vile? You're familiar with her? I've always found her rather mysterious...

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Will she really be able to... Well, I suppose it couldn't hurt to ask her.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Though — and I can't for the life of me say why — Jilliana seems to be very busy lately. I haven't seen her at all.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Lily just went off to play and I need to wait here till she comes back, so... could you please go find Vile for me?

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: More troublesome work...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, Rudolf wants to give Jilliana a present...

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Rudolf wants to give a gift to Jilliana.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Oh, my. Well, if you want a present, you've come to the right person. I am the best at picking presents for the people of Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Let me think for a moment. What sort of gift would be best? Rudolf, Jilliana, and... Ah yes, they have a daughter, Lily.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: A book? A flower? Toys? Well... let's just put them all in. And, of course, a surprise. A surprise is always necessary...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You don't need us to do anything?

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: No, not at all. It's just a little present, I'm happy to help.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Don't worry, there's nothing of any great price. Just a few things here and there... Let me wrap it for you.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Don't open it, now. A surprise must look the part.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Did you get the present?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, we did, but...

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Did something happen?

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Oh, so you got it very easily. But is that really a problem?

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: But that said, I should take the time to thank Vile for her help.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Alright. Thanks so much, just wait here for a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: I'll go pass this to Jilliana. She's out at work right now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Should you be doing that?

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Now's the perfect time. If I give her a gift while she's hard at work, it will lift her spirits a little.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Anyway, I know her schedule well. I'll pick a moment when she's not as busy to pass her the present.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Don't worry about it. Just wait here, I'll be right back.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, he left just like that. Rudolf really is nice to Jilliana, isn't he?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, we've never found out if Jilliana's liked the presents we picked for her or not.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Rudolf, too. He's never given those presents to her where we can see 'em before...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, maybe we can take this chance and see how she reacts! She'll love it, Paimon's sure of it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon wants to get presents from someone too...

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: ...Jilliana's not...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Jilliana's not there? Didn't you say you were going to give her the present?

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: ...Sorry, who was it that you said you got this present from?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: From Vile. Why?

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Vile, yes, that's right... You see, Jilliana started acting very strangely as soon as she opened it.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: She started stammering, saying that she'd forgotten something... and then she just ran off. I called out to her, but she wouldn't reply.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: ...Never mind. It's not your fault. It was I who asked you to get that present.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: She'd loved all the previous ones, so I just gave her the present directly this time around. Who could have known...

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Lily and Nora are still playing outside. Once she's back, I'll leave her in Sister Grace's care for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Then I'll go search for Jilliana... and find out what happened.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How did this happen? ...What in the world did Vile give us?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go back and ask her!

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Wow, you're back at last. I thought you'd... take longer.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: But it seems that Rudolf's quite spry.

choices.text: What in the world did you put into that present?

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Is that really the question you should be asking?

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: What I gave you is something you can ask me about at any time.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: But if you don't catch up to Jilliana now, it could be too late.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Well, let me think. Her general location should be... there, I've marked it out on the map for you.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Alright, don't look at me with so much suspicion. If you've got no faith in the location I gave you, you could always search the entirety of Mondstadt...

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Just go over there, quickly. If you're fast enough, maybe you'll be in time to see the show.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Oho, aren't you sharp? It seems your adventures weren't a waste of time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's... Jilliana! Why is she hanging out with those Treasure Hoarder types?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Also, she... seems to know that one Treasure Hoarder over there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's going on...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We should observe for now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh-huh. Let's stay here and watch for a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But if Jilliana's in danger, we have to be ready to help.

dialogues.speaker: Scrooge
dialogues.text: ... Jilliana, what do you mean, you're "not doing this anymore"?

dialogues.speaker: Scrooge
dialogues.text: You aren't thinking of breakin' off ties with your brothers, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Scrooge
dialogues.text: When the Boss led us on all that money-makin', and while we ate and got fat, you didn't tap out, did you?

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: Things are different now. I... I'm no longer a Treasure Hoarder.

dialogues.speaker: Scrooge
dialogues.text: Ha! How glib. So says you, but does what you say fly?

dialogues.speaker: Scrooge
dialogues.text: Think about it, Jilliana. The only reason why the Boss hasn't come after you yet is because we're covering for you. Old comrades and all, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Scrooge
dialogues.text: If not, what do you think the Boss would do to your husband and daughter, what with his temper and all?

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: No! Please! D—Don't hurt them. You... You just want money, right? I'll give it to you...

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: Th—This is all I have. And I've given you more besides in the past. Isn't that enough?

dialogues.speaker: Scrooge
dialogues.text: Just this much, enough? Forget it. We've lost quite a few gigs because you upped and bailed on us, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Scrooge
dialogues.text: You owe us that much. Isn't it just courtesy to add a little more on the side? Oh, how about this? I hear that the Cathedral has quite a lot of treasure, so why not...

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: No! I... I can't do such a shameful thing to Lord Barbatos!

dialogues.speaker: Scrooge
dialogues.text: Tch, look at you. You think you're really some kind of sister after a few days in a church? Once a Treasure Hoarder, always a Treasure Hoarder!

dialogues.speaker: Scrooge
dialogues.text: Did you really think that you could wash your hands of us, make a clean break and go live the cushy life once you'd earned enough cash?

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: You're... too much! Fine, then...

dialogues.speaker: Scrooge
dialogues.text: "Fine"? Fine what? "Fine, I'll fight you all, right here and now"?

dialogues.speaker: Scrooge
dialogues.text: Look at yourself, Jilliana. You're the same as ever. You never change.

dialogues.speaker: Scrooge
dialogues.text: You weren't bad in a fight, I'll give you that. But I've got a letter with your affairs written on it back home. If I don't return, that letter's going straight to the boss.

dialogues.speaker: Scrooge
dialogues.text: At that point, a bit of money from you every so often just ain't going to cut it.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: You're shameless!

dialogues.speaker: Scrooge
dialogues.text: Hahaha! Jilliana, we're Treasure Hoarders! "Shameless" is our middle name!

dialogues.speaker: Scrooge
dialogues.text: Go on, go tell the Knights of Favonius. Let them know that the respected Sister Jilliana is actually a Treasure Hoarder.

dialogues.speaker: Scrooge
dialogues.text: Look how she acts so compassionate in her guise as a sister! But who knows what thoughts such a person might have in private?

dialogues.speaker: Scrooge
dialogues.text: And as for your precious husband and daughter... I wonder, do they know what you've done? Or should I give them a little lecture?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That nasty man's about to hurt poor Jilliana! We gotta help her!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Attack!

dialogues.speaker: Scrooge
dialogues.text: Ha, whatever. I'm done talking shop with you. Go get those treasures inside the Cathedral. Or else...

response.speaker: Scrooge
response.text: Who are you, poking your noses into our business? Scram, or we'll get rid of you, too!

response.speaker: Scrooge
response.text: Oh, wait a minute! Ah, I get it. So this is what you meant by "not doing this anymore."

response.speaker: Scrooge
response.text: *chuckles* You're quite ruthless, aren't you? Had people lying in wait this whole time, looking to take us out.

response.speaker: Scrooge
response.text: But we aren't going to sit here and take it from you, either. Brothers, get them!

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: S—So it was you! How did you find this place...

response.speaker: Scrooge
response.text: Who are you, poking your noses into our business? Scram, or we'll get rid of you, too!

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: Y—You... What are you doing here?

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: Vile? How did she know...

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: ...Forget it. You were here for a while, so I'm sure you've put two and two together.

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: Sorry. I'd actually detected you a while back. You were hiding in those bushes in the corner, weren't you? You were pretty discreet overall, but you... overlooked a few details.

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: Don't be so disappointed. Observing our surroundings is the most basic of basics for me as a Treasure Hoarder.

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: Still, I only knew that there was someone in the bushes. At first, I thought Scrooge had laid an ambush for me. I never thought that it would be you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You were a Treasure Hoarder? But...

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: ...Haha, it's hard to imagine, isn't it? But before I met Rudolf, I did in fact roam the lands as a Treasure Hoarder.

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: Sometimes I'd gather intel in the city, sometimes I'd cheat passers-by out in the wild, and sometimes I'd go tomb raiding together with the other Hoarders...

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: We lived free... and empty lives. We'd make money and squander it. Then we'd be forced to find some way to make more money, which we would then squander again.

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: Everyone in the Treasure Hoarders would say that they're happy, but not one of us could escape that vicious cycle.

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: At least, that was until I met Rudolf, and had Lily...

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: I... didn't want to be a Treasure Hoarder anymore. So I left secretly, and fled to Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: It was Sister Victoria who took me in, then.

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: P—Please don't ask such questions. How am I supposed to answer? A—Anyway, it was all very complicated. I can't quite remember myself.

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: But eventually, Scrooge discovered that I had fled to Mondstadt, and he threatened Rudolf and Lily in order to extort money from me.

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: I was afraid, so I've been giving him money all this time. Today should have been the day for payment, and I was prepared to do it, but... the present that Rudolf gave me today...

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: I saw a Treasure Hoarder Insignia inside it...

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: That must have been Scrooge's way of saying that he can simply reach out and control my life as he pleases. I realized that if I continued like this, I would have collapsed, and so... I decided to come here and have it out with him.

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: I was prepared for any outcome... And then, you appeared.

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: Alright, I've said all that I wanted to say. Now that things have gotten to this point, I can't return to Mondstadt. The Treasure Hoarders won't stand for this...

choices.text: Rudolf is still waiting for you.

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: Rudolf... Lily... But how can I go back and face them now?

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: Haha, I suppose that at this point, I should indeed go to Sister Victoria to confess.

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: When she took me in, she didn't ask any questions. Even now, she probably doesn't know that I was once a Treasure Hoarder.

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: Thank you. I'll return to Mondstadt shortly.

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: There are... many things I still need to settle...

choices.text: Go back and tell Sister Victoria everything.
And then you became a sister?

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: I made it sound simple, but I did go through some trials in the process of becoming a sister. Fortunately, Rudolf and Lily stood by me.

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: I came here to settle some personal matters.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Huh. You left in a hurry just now. Where did you go?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, it was about Jilliana...

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Jilliana already came back. She said that she just remembered an errand she had to run for Sister Victoria, which is why she ran off in a hurry.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Still, I think that there's something strange here. The moment she got back, she said there was something else she had to do, leaving me all on my own once again.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: *sigh* How did this one present cause such a mess...

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Still, I should thank you for running around at my request this whole time. Please take these. Looks like I have to be careful in selecting presents in the future...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look out! They're coming!

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: What should I give...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What should I give...

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Hmm? You're also planning to give a present to someone?

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Picking gifts really is an adventure and a half, isn't it...

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: I want to give one to my wife Jilliana, but I have no idea what to pick.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Well, picking presents is like that. You might have a thousand things to choose from, but somehow it always feels impossible to find the perfect one...

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: *sigh* I really can't think of anything... And I'd ask someone in the city, if only I knew who best to ask.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Who exactly should I ask?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you know anything about presents?

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Presents? I've got a lot here. But what do you need them for?

choices.text: Rudolf wants to give someone a present.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: Rudolf? A present? Well sure, I've got a lot of good stuff here... But couldn't you at least tell me who the present is for?

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: "Someone" doesn't exactly give me a lot to go on.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: For Jilliana? I see, so it's for Rudolf's wife.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: Let me think. Ah, yes, I do have a present that she'll definitely like.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: That said... Hehe, did you bring enough money? This present will run you 900 Mora.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: A present for Jilliana? From you, I presume? You do need to tell me who it's from, because it makes quite a difference in what I'd recommend.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: Oh, it's from Rudolf... Hmm...

choices.text: Rudolf wants to give Jilliana a present...

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: Oh ho. You're quite experienced in helping people choose presents, aren't you? Your conditions are very clear — I can work with this.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: So this is a present that Rudolf wants to give to his wife Jilliana, right?

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: This is a tough one...

choices.text: Why do you want to give a present to Jilliana?

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: What do you mean, "why?" What sort of question is that?

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: The point of giving a gift is to give someone a nice surprise, make them happy.

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: Is there something so unusual about me wanting to make my wife happy?

choices.text: Do you give presents to Jilliana often?

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: Um... Not particularly, no... Just at weekends, and on Mondays... Oh, and on festivals, and on her birthday of course...

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: ...Hmm. So as I said, not that often at all! Hahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Small beans. Here you go!

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Hey, it looks like you don't have enough money on hand. Why don't you go save some more up first.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: There's no discount on this present, so you'll have to come back later and buy it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About that present...

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: What sort of good ideas could Sara have?

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: No matter how I look at it, it can only be some sort of house specialty.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Wouldn't it be a bit too plain to give something like this as a gift?

dialogues.speaker: Norma
dialogues.text: As expected, ordering food is much more convenient...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why not learn a few more dishes?

dialogues.speaker: Norma
dialogues.text: I wish I could... if I could go to Liyue, perhaps I could learn a few new tricks.

dialogues.speaker: Norma
dialogues.text: But I don't have that kind of free time...

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Why would you want to look for Quinn...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is something wrong with Quinn?

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Huh? No, I'm not saying that there's something wrong with Quinn. I just think that if you want to send people presents...

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Well, I'd say that Beatrice is the better person to ask.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Why would you want to look for Quinn...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is something wrong with Quinn?

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Huh? No, I'm not saying that there's something wrong with Quinn. I just think that if you want to send people presents...

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Well, I'd say that Beatrice is the better person to ask.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Ugh, my stocks are running low, and I still need to open for business tomorrow...

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: What am I going to do about that cart...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I wonder what this present is?

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Well, I have no clue either. I didn't open it.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: But not to worry, Beatrice is very good at picking gifts out for people, so there should be no problem.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: *sigh* Whatever will I do about that cart...

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Remember, it's sturdy wooden planks. Don't go looking for the wrong thing, now.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Those monsters...

response.speaker: Quinn
response.text: Of course. It's just a group of monsters. I'll go look for the Knights of Favonius shortly.

response.speaker: Quinn
response.text: Besides, if anything were to happen to those goods, I would have difficulty doing business tomorrow.

response.speaker: Quinn
response.text: Not to mention Beatrice. She always wants me to save a few fruits for her.

response.speaker: Quinn
response.text: If I don't do that tomorrow, I'll never hear the end of it.

response.speaker: Quinn
response.text: No, it's alright. Don't you go telling her either. This doesn't have anything to do with her.

response.speaker: Quinn
response.text: This is my store, and my business. I'll solve any problems that crop up by myself.

response.speaker: Quinn
response.text: It's that simple.

dialogues.speaker: Norma
dialogues.text: *sigh* I should just eat in...

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Have you gotten a present from Quinn?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's been some trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: ...The carts? Again? He does like to make sure he gets the freshest produce, doesn't he. That's why he sources from outside the city.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: The trouble is, if they take one of the quieter routes they're likely to get ambushed by monsters. They'll scare off the driver and then destroy the cart and all its goods.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Knowing Quinn, though, he won't abandon the goods if he can help it.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: He's a tough nut to crack, that Quinn... No idea where he gets it from.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you just tell me what's in this dish?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: No! Gifts are supposed to be surprises, I can't be telling you that.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: If you must know, you can always ask Jilliana.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Though I'm quite certain she won't tell you either.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: How peculiar... Jilliana is ever so busy at work, all of a sudden...

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Wow, you're back already. You were quicker than I thought.

choices.text: What were you playing at, putting that thing in the gift!?

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Hey, don't you take that aggressive tone with me. I didn't create Jilliana's problems, alright? The Treasure Hoarders have been extorting her for a very long time already.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Jilliana will do whatever that guy tells her to in order to protect the life of relative peace she has carved out for herself. She doesn't even try to stand up to him.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: If she wanted, she could just tell Rudolf the truth, and report the whole affair to the Knights of Favonius.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: After all, who's to say Rudolf isn't already aware of his wife's shady past? Maybe he already came to terms with it a long time ago...

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: But Jilliana is not about to take a chance on that "maybe," let alone tell anything to the Knights of Favonius.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Instead, she puts herself at the complete mercy of that guy's demands. If she carries on down this path, sooner or later she's going to run into something far more serious than money troubles.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Sure, it's painful to face your demons. But so is prolonging the agony. She needs to act a little more ruthlessly to get herself out of the mess she's in and avoid disastrous consequences down the line.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: So, on instructions from a certain gentleman, I took the opportunity presented by this gift to send Jilliana a little knightly assistance, in the form of your gallant self.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: His goal? Oh, he said I was free to share that with you.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: He said that even though the Treasure Hoarders can come in handy occasionally, he draws the line at working with anyone who "threatens other people's family."

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: He also said, and I quote: "People like that are criminal to the core... all they deserve is to be hunted down and destroyed."

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: However, the Knights aren't exactly low key in the way they operate. If they got involved, the first thing to happen would be everyone in the city finding out about Jilliana's personal history...

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: There's also no guarantee that they could beat the Treasure Hoarders. They are a highly devious bunch. So, sending you in as a lone ranger was the only option.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Come on now, don't frown at me. Seriously, if you're looking for someone to blame, it should be that guy you're such good friends with.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: Oh, you're back. I... I'm plucking up the courage now to go and confess to Sister Victoria.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: I do hope that Sister Victoria will hear my confession.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: I do hope that Sister Victoria can accept my repentance.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: But a sinner like me... *chuckles*

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Why, how carefree of you to stay here and chat with me. Shouldn't you be going after Jilliana?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's your game?

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Me? Don't misunderstand me. This wasn't my idea. Or perhaps, I should say that the intent behind what happened wasn't mine.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Come on, I'm just an errand runner... If a certain gentleman hadn't pressed me so hard, I wouldn't have had to resort to this.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Ah... Ugh, I said a little too much. Well, that gentleman and you are such close acquaintances, and it was he who requested that you handle this anyway. If you have grievances, take them up with him.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: As to who he is... Haha, if I told you that, I might go hungry. So please try to understand.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: ...What in the world happened?

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: I have to go ask Vile first...

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: But Lily still isn't back yet...

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: For Rudolf and Lily's sake... I can't go on like this...

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: Ah. Wh—What are you doing here? Are you going to the Cathedral?

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: I... I'm just worried about my work. We've been terribly busy lately, and there's been no time to spend with Lily.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: With Rudolf, too... Once our work is done for the time being, I'll go spend some time with them.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: I have to spend some time with them...

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Why are you still here? Go on now, this surprise is best given sooner, rather than later.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Hmm, and today's the right day, too. Jilliana will definitely like it.
